diff_summary: Added typed liveness and readiness endpoints, with an exact-path lease middleware bypass. Readiness reuses health() and reports missing or invalid leases as down; liveness returns no-store.

verification.command: env APP_ENV=local PYTHONPATH=backend DATABASE_URL=postgresql://127.0.0.1:1/unreachable MONGODB_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:1 .venv/bin/pytest -q backend/tests/test_security_headers.py -k health && .venv/bin/ruff check backend/app/main.py && .venv/bin/ruff format --check backend/app/main.py
